hypothesised_pattern: Target class follows x2*x5 and x4^2 jointly: same-sign x2 and x5 give class_1, opposite signs give class_0, and class_2 replaces both when x4^2 outweighs twice |x2*x5|.
functional_form_guess: predict class_2 if x4^2 - 0.25 > 2*|x2*x5|, else class_1 if x2*x5 > 0, else class_0
rationale: All ten examples fit the rule. Idx 1 and 5 have x4^2 of about 1.2 to 1.3 but |x2*x5| of about 1.0, so they stay in class 1 and class 0, while idx 2 and 8 have similar x4^2 and |x2*x5| near 0.1 and are class 2. That contrast shows the outcome depends on the comparison between the two terms and not on |x4| alone.
